'''Collor Pondrat''' was a company that manufactured [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] vehicles, favoring large, intimidating designs.

[[File:SebulbaPodracer1-SWE.png|thumb|250px|Plug-F ''Mammoth'', a Collor Pondrat product.]]

They produced the Podracers of both [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo]] and [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]]; the [[Plug-F Mammoth Split-X engine/Legends|Plug-F Mammoth]] and the [[Plug-G Gargantua]] owned by Sebulba, and the [[Plug-2 Behemoth]] owned by Mars Guo.
